title: Oozing Chinese Pork Twice Cooked Pork
description: A smoky, tender twice-cooked pork dish that cures hangovers and warms the soul, served on a wooden board with fresh scallion garnish.

ingredients.name: soy sauce and Shaoxing wine mixture
ingredients.notes: 3 tbsp soy sauce + 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine

instructions: Slice pork belly into 2cm cubes and pat dry.
In a bowl combine soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, brown sugar, five spice, salt, pepper, garlic, and ginger and whisk until sugar dissolved.
Toss pork cubes in the marinating mixture and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, then add pork and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly cooked; remove and drain.
Heat a wok over medium‑high, add vegetable oil and sauté pork until it turns golden and releases fat, about 4 minutes.
Add scallion and stir to combine.
Drizzle smoky sesame oil over pork, toss quickly, and remove from heat.
Plate pork on a wooden board and garnish with sliced scallion.
Serve hot as a hangover cure with steamed rice.
